title: Preserve identifier systems and key constraints
objective: Keys are typed by identifier system, entity and validity period.
outcome: CCN, NPI, FIPS/GEOID, source report IDs, tax identifiers and plan identifiers keep source-specific formatting, entity role and leading zeros. CCN and NPI are never interchangeable; equal strings from different systems do not establish identity. Candidate, composite, foreign-key and display-label roles require documentation or scoped sample evidence. Observed uniqueness is not full-release uniqueness. Composite facility/report/year keys remain composite. An identifier match outside its applicability period is ambiguous or incompatible, not exact. No automatic name-based merge is added. All key checks report sampled versus full-release evidence scope. Sealed packages/identity/src/exact-identifier-policy.mjs and schema-catalog.mjs are not edited.

commits.subject: Define identifier-system metadata
commits.instructions: Represent CCN, NPI, FIPS/GEOID, source report IDs, tax identifiers and plan identifiers with source-specific formatting and entity role. Preserve leading zeros.
commits.verification: CCN and NPI are never interchangeable; equal strings from different systems do not establish identity.

commits.subject: Attach key roles to exact fields
commits.instructions: Record candidate key, composite key, foreign key or display label only with documentation or scoped sample evidence. Separate observed uniqueness from full-release uniqueness.
commits.verification: A sample unique identifier is not certified globally; composite facility/report/year keys remain composite.

commits.subject: Validate identity and historical scope
commits.instructions: Add retired/reused IDs, changed geography vintage and multiple identifiers per organization to fixtures. Keep human-reviewed resolution decisions versioned.
commits.verification: An identifier match outside its applicability period becomes ambiguous or incompatible, not exact.
